hero.sub: Niveshak SafeGuard teaches you to spot red flags, measures how much FOMO drives your decisions, and warns you before you act — in your language, with no trading and no advice.

features.title: Three tools that keep you safe

educator.title: AI finance educator
educator.body: Ask simple questions about SIPs, mutual funds, SEBI rules and more — answered in your language by an AI trained on official investor-education material.

fomo.title: FOMO meter
fomo.body: A 6-question quiz scores how impulsive your investing style is, so you can notice when urgency — not research — is driving the decision.

scanner.title: Tip & screenshot fraud scanner
scanner.body: Got a tip on Telegram or Instagram? Upload a screenshot and our AI checks it for warning signs like guaranteed-return claims. Your screenshot is never stored.
